title: Category:Woods
wikitext:
This category contains articles on wooded areas such as woods, jungles, glades, thickets, wealds, and timberlands.

This category should list [[subzone]]s that are primarily wooded and [[zone]]s not-primarily wooded, but with small some wooded areas. Zones that are primarily wooded should go in the [[:Category:Forests|Forests category]] (which this category is a subcategory of).
